name: The World of Hyatt Credit Card

tripDelay.notes: Up to $500 per ticket for delays of 12+ hours or delays requiring an overnight stay. Must book travel with this card.

tripCancellation.notes: Covers non-refundable prepaid travel expenses. Maximum $10,000 per trip, $20,000 per account per 12 months.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (electronics, jewelry) limited to $500 per item.

baggageDelay.notes: $100 per day for up to 5 days when checked baggage is delayed 6+ hours.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services: 24/7 referral coordination for medical emergencies, legal assistance, and evacuation. Actual costs of transportation and services are cardholder's responsibility.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary rental car coverage — no need to file with personal auto insurance first. Save $10–30/day by declining the CDW at the counter. Covers vehicles up to 31 consecutive days.

otherCredits.name: Free Night Award
otherCredits.notes: One Category 1-4 free night award (up to 15,000 points) every account anniversary. Plus, earn a second Category 1-4 free night award after spending $15,000 on the card in a calendar year.

rewards.travelRate: 4x at Hyatt hotels worldwide; 2x on airlines, local transit, and commuting
rewards.diningRate: 2x at restaurants, cafes, and coffee shops

otherBonusCategories.category: Hyatt hotels (4x from card + 5x base Hyatt member points)

pointValue.transferPartners: 1.5–2.5¢ per World of Hyatt point; one of the most valuable hotel points programs

emergencyContacts.benefitsCenter: Visit chase.com or call the number on back of card
